Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1 demonstrates bilateral alveolar-interstitial opacities that are more prominent in the lower lung zones, while Figure 4 reveals a dramatic worsening with dense, diffuse bilateral consolidations. This rapid progression from interstitial markings to extensive airspace disease is highly characteristic of diffuse alveolar hemorrhage.
